title: 请美国邻居帮忙（收快递/浇花），英语怎么说？
summary: 出远门请邻居帮忙收快递、浇花很常见。这篇教你怎么开口、怎么道谢，人情往来一次搞定。

featuredPhrase.en: Can I ask you a favor?

phrases.en: Can I ask you a favor?
Could you pick up my packages while I'm away?
phrases.zh: 我出门期间能帮我收下包裹吗？

phrases.en: Let me know if you need anything.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi John, can I ask you a favor?
dialogue.zh: 你好 John，能请你帮个忙吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: We're going on vacation next week. Could you pick up my packages?
dialogue.zh: 我们下周出去旅游。能帮我收下包裹吗？

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: No problem at all. How long will you be gone?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Just five days. I owe you one! Let me know if you need anything.
dialogue.zh: 就五天。我欠你一个人情！有需要帮忙的跟我说。

dialogue.speaker: Neighbor
dialogue.en: Will do. Have a great trip!

seoTitle: 请邻居帮忙英文怎么说？
seoDescription: 出远门怎么请美国邻居帮忙收快递、浇花？本文教你开口和道谢的英语说法，附完整对话。
